name: Predicted-region joint key/value memory modulation
motivation: RMNet computes a mask-derived regional map and multiplies both memory keys and values. The prior two SAM2 value-only pilots had negligible Dice impact. This candidate moves bounded region gains to the SAM2 memory stream before its separate key/value projections, changing both content keys and values while leaving added positional encoding, pointers, token count and frame schedule intact.
method: For each of SAM2's four memory-attention layers, learn per-channel multiplicative gains for foreground, mixed-boundary and background memory vectors before key/value projection. Initialize gains at 1 and bound them to [0.75, 1.25]. Apply only to spatial memory; preserve pointer vectors and positional encodings. Keep all tokens and all other SAM2 modules unchanged.

prior_work.adaptation: RMNet computes a predicted-mask regional map and multiplies projected memory keys and values. This SAM2 adaptation applies predicted-region gains to the unprojected memory content before SAM2 separately adds positional encoding to K and projects K and V. This allows region-specific content modulation in both paths while preserving positional terms, all tokens and pointer tokens; it does not import RMNet optical-flow tracking or its architecture.
prior_work.MMN_code_status: No official public repository was located during this survey; no MMN implementation is claimed.

model.initialization: Gain logits are zero; gain is exactly 1, so memory and native K/V inputs are unchanged.

data.scope: Exploratory only: PolypGen informed earlier analyses and candidate design; patient-to-sequence independence is unverified.

training.loss: Mean author-compatible post-prompt decoder BCE plus Dice mask loss and object-presence loss across sampled clips.

evaluation.primary: Equal-sequence mean present-frame Dice over seq16-seq23.
evaluation.success_screen: At least +0.01 equal-sequence Dice over native, higher Dice on at least 6/8 sequences, and no increase in pooled false alarms on GT-empty frames.
evaluation.interpretation: One seed is a screening experiment, not reliable confirmation. A positive result requires a second pre-specified seed and an untouched external dataset before a general performance claim.
